content: It'd better if you could consider setting the status of your contribution to WIP to allow for a proper review and necessary adjustments before opening it for approval by others. I haven't read the statement in detail or done any play-testing yet. The following points are based on a quick initial scan: Rules * Please limit formatting to the variable names only, excluding other characters such as brackets, commas, operators, inequality signs and numbers. Victory Conditions and Defeat Conditions * These sections are missing. Please refer to other bot game contributions for the standard HTML code to use. Initialization Input / Input for One Game Turn * All lines: Please specify the format and variable types (e.g. 3 space-separated integers, or an integer). * Please format all line numbers using the "" tag. Output for One Game Turn * Please change "Output one line per owned ship" to "One line per owned ship". * The formatting comment above also applies here. Thanks.

General
* Refer to the replay in Wood 3: https://www.codingame.com/replay/929144828 . A few behaviours are unclear:
  - Why do some treasure chests disappear within the first few turns?
  - Why do some chests move around?
  - Why does the amount of Gold in some chests change?

  The Input section and the stub comment describe chests as "active", though it's unclear how a chest becomes inactive.

  Please clarify these behaviours in the statement and/or fix the game code if appropriate.

* In the same replay, the end screen displays "454 Gold (+4 aboard)". According to the victory conditions, "Gold aboard" doesn't appear to contribute to the final score. Why is the amount displayed?

League 3 introduction & Rules
* It's unclear what "variable cargo mass" refers to.

Turn Resolution Order
* The Maelstrom Vortex

  - "a counter-clockwise swirl and inward suction vector are added to every ship's velocity each turn": Could the relevant formulas be added to a new "Expert Rules" section?

  - Please clarify whether a shipwrecked ship has both its vx and vy reset to 0 when it respawns.

  - Please include the word "currents" here so that it's clear that "currents" mentioned under the point "Kinematics & Water Drag" refer to the effects of the vortex.

* Cannons

  - "blasted away from the impact point": Could the relevant formulas be added to a new "Expert Rules" section?

  - What does "plundered directly" mean? How does this differ from the situation in which an enemy isn't hit?

* Plunder & Delivery

  - Do "passing" and "entering" mean that a ship collects or delivers Gold if it comes within the relevant distance at any point along its movement path during a turn, or is only its final position considered?

  - Please clarify what happens when multiple ships pass within 85 units of the same treasure chest during the same turn. Can multiple ships collect its Gold?

  - Is it possible for a ship to collect Gold and deliver it to its Home Port during the same turn?

* Before the paragraph on unexecutable actions, please clarify what happens when a ship reaches the sector boundary. Does it stop at the boundary?

Victory Conditions
* Please remove "(with a strictly higher score than your opponent)", as the game doesn't define a separate concept of score.

Initialization Input
* (Wood 3 only) Please add the following:
The Maelstrom has no effect in the current league.

Output for One Game Turn
* Please add "(<action>SAIL</action> or <action>ANCHOR</action>)" after "one movement command".

* Please add ", or a standalone cannot shot" at the end of the first paragraph.

* Please replace the middle paragraph ("A SAIL or… standalone):") with:
A cannot shot is issued using the following syntax:

Constraints
* The lower bound of `chestCount` is stated as 0. Does this mean that all treasure chests can be collected during a game? It may be more useful to specify the constraint on the *initial* number of chests instead.

* Please add a constraint on `gold`.

Thanks.
